title: Norm-of-representation-sphere identity N^G_H S^W ≅ S^{Ind W} is mis-cited (load-bearing in Prop phiNT)

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
Proposition `prop:phiNT` ($\Phi^G(N^T S^1)\simeq S^{|T/G|}$) is the computational engine of the forward direction (Lemma forward) and of the geometric upper bound (Lemma geom). Its Step 1 uses the identity
$$N^G_H S^{W}\;\cong\;S^{\,\mathrm{Ind}_H^G W},$$
citing `[HHR16, Prop. B.96]`. However, the *same* citation `[HHR16, Prop. B.96]` is simultaneously attached in the solution to two other, logically distinct, statements: (i) the geometric-fixed-point formula for norms $\Phi^G N^{G/H}\simeq\Phi^H i_H^*$ (eq. phinorm), and (ii) $\Phi^G S^V\simeq S^{V^G}$ (eq. phiSV). A single proposition cannot be all three results.

The norm-of-representation-sphere identity (ii) is precisely the step that converts the abstract norm $N^{G/H}S^1$ into a concrete permutation-representation sphere $S^{\mathbb R\cdot(G/H)}$, and hence underlies the entire connectivity computation. As written, this load-bearing step rests on an incorrect/ambiguous citation.

**To close:** either give the correct, specific reference for $N^G_H S^V\cong S^{\mathrm{Ind}_H^G V}$, or supply the short direct argument: the HHR norm $N^G_H$ is the indexed smash power $X\mapsto \bigwedge_{G/H} X$ with $G$ permuting the factors; on the one-point compactification $S^W=W^+$ this indexed smash is the one-point compactification of the indexed direct sum $\bigoplus_{G/H}W=\mathrm{Ind}_H^G W$, giving $N^G_H S^W\cong S^{\mathrm{Ind}_H^G W}$. The statement is **true**; only its justification is currently missing. (Note: the multiplicativity $N^{T_0\sqcup T_1}=N^{T_0}\otimes N^{T_1}$ and $S^{\mathbb R\cdot(T_0\sqcup T_1)}=S^{\mathbb R\cdot T_0}\wedge S^{\mathbb R\cdot T_1}$ then reduce the general $T$ to a single orbit, as the proof already says.)
